character: Lowest and sunniest village in Tignes. Traditional Savoyard hamlet atmosphere. Stone and wood architecture. Quiet, family-friendly. Good value. Separate gondola access to ski area.
dining: Restaurant at Brevières gondola. Village restaurants, bar.
activities_nearby: Gondola to Tignes ski area. Hiking, snowshoeing. Escaping the purpose-built feel of upper Tignes.
